notes: Risk classification rules for the VOLA dev engine. A run's risk starts at the
issue's explicit '## Risk' value (or default_risk when absent) and each matching
rule may only RAISE it. raise_only is asserted by the validator: an agent may
never lower a risk a human wrote on the ticket.

rules.reason: auth / security boundary — human-gated, see policy.json human_gate
schema migration present — silent-skip and collision hazards are documented in CLAUDE.md; destructive migrations are human-gated
deploy / CI configuration — a wrong edit here disarms the gates themselves
destructive or billing work by label
offline-first sync and reconciliation — the T5–T8 trap family lives here; races pass tests and lose athlete data
public API contract — breaking changes strand installed mobile builds
native dependency / app config — permission traps and stale-binary hazards only surface in a built binary
